subject: Private deployment DPA: EU data routing, subprocessors & signature
messages:
From: Alice Barton <alice@orchardai.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T15:12:00Z
Subject: DPA for Private deployment — subprocessors & on-prem routing

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving forward with a private/VPC deployment and need to get the DPA finalized before procurement can sign off. A couple of non-negotiables for our legal team: 

- No cross-border transfer of customer data: data at rest and in transit must remain within the EU for our instance.
- Subprocessor freeze: we need a fixed list of subprocessors for the private deployment and prior notice + opt-out windows for additions.
- KMS/HSM integration: keys must be customer-managed (bring-your-own-key).
- Audit evidence: SOC2 report + ability to provide anonymized access logs on request.

Can you send your redline and confirm whether DocuSign is fine for signature? Also, if there are any service-level impacts or pricing deltas for the above constraints (e.g., Dedicated vs Private), flag them.

Best,
Alice
Alice Barton
Head of IT & Security, Orchard AI

Attachment: procurement_requirements_Orchard.pdf (reference)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Barton <alice@orchardai.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA for Private deployment — subprocessors & on-prem routing

Alice — thanks for the clear list. Attached is an initial redline (DPA_Redline_PV2.docx) that maps our standard Private deployment clauses to your asks. High level:

- We can commit to EU-only data routing for the Private/VPC deployment and add explicit routing language.
- For subprocessors, we propose a fixed matrix for the first 12 months with a 60-day notification window for additions; we can discuss opt-out semantics.
- BYOK/KMS support is available but we need to confirm the exact HSM integrations with infra ops.
- SOC 2 + logs: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report and agreed-upon access to redacted logs.

I've looped in Marissa (legal) and Karthik (solutions) to review operational impacts and finalize the redline. Is Friday for signature too aggressive, or would you prefer next week? DocuSign works for us.

—Rafael
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA_Redline_PV2.docx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-30T09:00:00Z
Subject: Fwd: DPA for Private deployment — inputs from Orchard (need legal + ops review)

Team — forward from Orchard AI. Highlights for review: EU-only routing, subprocessor freeze, BYOK, SOC2 evidence. Key asks from me:

1) Can Legal accept a 12-month frozen subprocessor list with 60-day notice and an explicit opt-out right for the customer (i.e., terminate services if certain subprocessors are added)?
2) Ops: what is the integration effort and risk for BYOK/HSM for Private (on-prem/VPC)? Is there a pricing uplift vs our Dedicated offering?
3) If we cannot meet BYOK in the requested timeframe, can we offer a mitigations package (e.g., dedicated key tenant, strict KMS policies) and capture that in the DPA?

Please annotate the attached redline and the subprocessor matrix I requested from sourcing. I want to send back a legally-ready redline + DocuSign link to Alice by EOD.

Thanks,
Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA for Private deployment — inputs from Orchard (need legal + ops review)

Rafael — quick legal summary after an initial pass (see inline bullets). I also attached the current subprocessor_matrix.csv.

- Subprocessors: We can agree to a 12-month locked baseline (list attached) with a 60-day notice. However, "opt-out + terminate" language is high risk: propose conditional opt-out where customer may suspend data processing or require a migration window; termination only for material breaches tied to the added subprocessor.
- EU-only routing: acceptable for Private deployments that are deployed into customer-controlled VPCs/regions. Add explicit language that we will not route or replicate production data outside the specified EU region for that tenant.
- BYOK/HSM: legal is fine with contractual language, but we need Ops confirmation on supported key providers (AWS KMS CMKs, Azure Key Vault HSM, Vault with HSM). Include an implementation checklist and a change-control clause for key rotations.
- Audit evidence: provide SOC2 Type II and monthly access-log extracts. For on-prem Private customers, define a secure process for log export.

Next steps from Legal: I redlined sections 2, 5, and 9 (data routing, subprocessors, security controls). If Ops confirms BYOK compatibility this afternoon, we can proceed to DocuSign. If Ops needs more time, propose a conditional addendum that captures BYOK milestone and associated timeline.

Attachments: subprocessor_matrix.csv (current list)

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Marissa Cole | marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Barton <alice@orchardai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T14:30:00Z
Subject: Updated DPA redline + DocuSign link (EU-only routing / subprocessors)

Alice — thanks for the checklist and patience. Per our legal/ops review we attached an updated DPA redline that: 

- Commits to EU-only data routing for your Private tenant (explicit clause added).
- Establishes a 12-month baseline of subprocessors (matrix attached) with 60-day notice for additions; termination remedies limited to material breaches, with a suspension/migration option available.
- Confirms BYOK support for AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault HSM; Karthik will send a short implementation runbook and the expected timeline (3–4 weeks).
- Provides SOC2 Type II and a log-extract procedure for periodic evidence.

Action items: 
1) Please review the attached DPA_Redline_PV2.docx (redline) and subprocessor_matrix.csv.
2) If acceptable, sign via the DocuSign link below — we set the envelope for two signers (Orchard IT + Orchard Legal) and Redwood counter-sign.
